persistence.migration: additive tables; legacy digest-only checkpoints remain readable and cannot be resumed by the reference trainer
persistence.commit_boundary: checkpoint metadata and full payload commit in one fenced BEGIN IMMEDIATE transaction
persistence.rollback: preserve existing manifests and checkpoints; older code may read digest-only checkpoints but cannot claim payload-backed resume

binding.document_sequence_digest: sha256 of canonical JSON document sequence; preserves document boundaries beyond the registered newline corpus digest

resume_payload.model: complete ReferenceNGramModel.to_dict() counts; null only at the initial cursor-zero checkpoint
resume_payload.identity: payload_digest is included in TrainingCheckpoint identity and verified on every payload read
resume_payload.step_semantics: cumulative estimator token observations using the model tokenizer, including each document EOS; document completion is the replay boundary
resume_payload.budget_semantics: max_steps, max_documents and max_corpus_bytes bound total committed corpus work, including work completed before restart; max_batches bounds cumulative committed batches

recovery: persist initial cursor-zero checkpoint before counting model transitions
validate exact manifest, governed dataset, split, corpus document sequence and model configuration before executing or reloading
recover running or failed run by advancing worker epoch and invalidating old leases
a payload-bound run interrupted before its initial checkpoint may recover only at cursor zero after advancing the worker epoch; generic legacy runs still require a durable checkpoint
load latest full counts and continue after the last committed document without retraining prior batches
reload completed artifact idempotently without model training or state mutation
fence checkpoint, failure, telemetry and completion against the current lease inside the SQLite write transaction
failures: payload or binding corruption fails closed
immutable retry conflict fails before model work
stale workers cannot terminalize or overwrite replacement work
budget exhaustion retains the last valid durable checkpoint
legacy digest-only checkpoints cannot masquerade as resumable model state
scope_limitations: no neural optimizer or collective execution
